info.desc: Sign "O" the Times, stylized as Sign “☮” the Times, is the ninth studio album by musician Prince, released March 31, 1987 on the Paisley Park record label. The album is the follow-up to Parade (1986), and Prince's first "solo" album following his departure from The Revolution; the symbol between the quotes is a peace sign. The album's music draws on funk, soul, psychedelic pop, and rock music. Sign o' the Times features lyrical themes such as the depressing state of the world in the title track, gender identity/androgyny in "If I Was Your Girlfriend", party funk in "Housequake", sexual .
